description: Source code for NXP SAI driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing configuration, ISR, and control functions for audio interface.

methods.name: sai_mclk_config
methods.description: Configures the master clock for the SAI device based on the provided clock source and bespoke configuration.

methods.name: sai_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine handling FIFO errors for TX and RX directions.

methods.name: sai_get_properties
methods.description: Returns properties of the specified DAI direction.

methods.name: sai_config_set_err_051421
methods.description: Applies specific configuration adjustments for i.MX93 errata related to BCLK and sync modes.

methods.name: sai_config_set
methods.description: Sets the configuration for the SAI device, including protocol, clock, FIFO, and sync modes.

methods.name: sai_dir_disable
methods.description: Disables the specified direction (TX or RX) of the SAI interface, waiting for hardware disablement.

methods.name: sai_tx_rx_disable
methods.description: Disables both TX and RX directions, handling sync/async modes and timeouts.

methods.name: sai_trigger_pause
methods.description: Pauses the specified direction, disabling data lines and updating states.

methods.name: sai_trigger_stop
methods.description: Stops the specified direction, disabling DMA, data lines, and error interrupts.

methods.name: sai_tx_rx_sw_reset
methods.description: Performs software reset on TX and RX directions based on sync modes and current enable states.

methods.name: sai_trigger_start
methods.description: Starts the specified direction, configuring hardware, enabling DMA, data lines, and interrupts.

methods.name: sai_trigger
methods.description: Handles trigger commands (start, pause, stop, etc.) for the SAI device.

methods.name: sai_probe
methods.description: Device probe function, currently does nothing.

methods.name: sai_remove
methods.description: Device removal function, currently does nothing.

methods.name: sai_init
methods.description: Initializes the SAI device, maps registers, enables clocks, and registers IRQ.
